meta.title: Jobs at Our School
meta.textType: functional: a fact page about jobs, a blog post

paragraphs: Posted by Lily and May on Monday, July twentieth. Who works at our school? Many adults work here, and each person has a job. We walked around the school with a notebook. We visited five people and asked about their day. May asked the questions, and Lily wrote all the answers in her notebook. Here is what we learned.

Nurse Jill works in the nurse's room. She has a white uniform with a small red cross. "What time do you begin, Nurse Jill?" asked May. "I begin at eight o'clock in the morning," said Nurse Jill. "I finish at three o'clock in the afternoon." She puts a bandage on a small cut. She keeps the medicine in a box on a high shelf. Students come to her room when they are sick.

The cook begins at six o'clock in the morning. She makes lunch for four hundred students. The kitchen is hot and busy at eleven o'clock. Lunch is at twelve o'clock in the big hall. "What else do you do?" asked May. "I wash the big pots after lunch," said the cook. "Then I plan the lunch for tomorrow."

The bus driver makes two trips every day. The first trip is at seven o'clock in the morning. The second trip is at half past three in the afternoon. The driver also looks at the bus before each trip. The cleaner begins at half past five. The school is clean before the first student comes. The secretary works in the office. She answers the phone and writes letters to parents.

All these workers are our school staff. Their daily work helps every student here. We thank all of them for their time. Which job do you like? What else would you like to know? Please write to us on Explorers' Blog.
